items.title: Vite: The Ultra-Fast Bundling Tool
items.content: Compared to Webpack, Vite offers deep optimizations for production builds, resulting in smaller, more efficient, and more convenient outputs.

items.title: Latest Pinia state management library
items.content: Pinia is Vue's exclusive state management library that allows you to share state across components or pages.

items.title: Multilingual internationalization I18n
items.content: Makes it easier for you to implement multilingual configuration.

items.title: Code highlighting with Highlight.js
items.content: Makes document code clearer and 'what you see is what you get'.

items.title: Modularity
items.content: Modular management of UI components makes the structure clearer.
